headline: 400,000 shareholders affected! Yung Guan-KY again crosses red line, stock remains suspended from trading | ETtoday Finance Cloud | ETtoday News Cloud
summary: Yung Guan-KY (1589) breached listing rules after all three independent directors resigned and no by-election was completed in time. Its stock remains suspended and will move to a changed trading method from August 13.
why: Taiwan Stock Exchange listing rules require listed companies to maintain sufficient independent directors, and breaches can lead to restricted trading. Governance failures can weigh on share prices and liquidity.
